title: Disjunction and negated conjunction
statement: Let $l$ be a list of natural numbers, and let $p$ and $q$ be Boolean-valued predicates such that $p(a)=\neg q(a)$ for every $a$ in $l$. Then the listwise disjunction of $p$ over $l$ is the negation of the listwise conjunction of $q$ over $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
For every element of $l$, $p$ is the Boolean complement of $q$
